theorem lg_target {r x : ℝ} : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x := by
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) x := Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
  have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun a => Real.exp (-(r * a))) (Real.exp (-(r * x)) * (-r)) x :=
    HasDerivAt.exp h_exp (by simp)
  simp only [mul_neg, neg_mul] at h_comp
  exact HasDerivAt.neg h_comp
